projects.name: The Quality Kitchen
projects.description: A food-focused website combining editorial typography and food photography with a filterable menu, portion selection, a basket, and WhatsApp enquiries.

caseStudy.headline: Good food. A considered ordering experience.
caseStudy.intro: A food website designed around the moments people gather, with generous photography, editorial type, and a practical route from the menu to an enquiry.
caseStudy.challenge: Bring the food, the story, and the ordering details into one place. Visitors need to understand the offering, choose the right portions, and reach the kitchen without a complicated checkout.
caseStudy.solution: A photography-led homepage introduces the kitchen and its food. A filterable menu, portion selection, and a gathering basket turn browsing into an organised WhatsApp enquiry.
features: Portion selection and a gathering basket
caseStudy.design: A dark editorial palette frames the food, while warm accents and large serif headlines give the site the feel of a considered hospitality brand.

projects.name: NURA
projects.alt: NURA homepage showing Signature of Heritage with perfume and perfume oil
projects.description: A curated fragrance storefront with an emerald and gold identity, editorial typography, perfume and oil collections, scent details, size selection, a shopping bag, and WhatsApp ordering.

caseStudy.headline: A signature of heritage, translated to the web.
caseStudy.intro: A digital storefront for NURA by Bin Sadhik, bringing a curated fragrance collection into an immersive emerald and gold experience.
caseStudy.challenge: Give perfume and concentrated perfume oil a shared home while keeping the collection easy to understand. Visitors should be able to explore the character of a fragrance, compare formats, and choose a size.
caseStudy.solution: An atmospheric product-led introduction leads into fragrance discovery. Product details, scent notes, format and size selection, and a shopping bag support a personal ordering conversation on WhatsApp.
features: Perfume and concentrated perfume oil collections
caseStudy.design: Deep green textures, a restrained gold accent, and expressive serif typography reflect the existing NURA identity. Product imagery carries the visual story throughout the site.

projects.name: Prompt Pop 2K26
projects.description: An AI prompting and design competition platform with team-code entry, a timed quiz, image recreation, a comedy bonus, logo design, and results access.

caseStudy.headline: A competition experience with something to play for.
caseStudy.intro: An interactive platform for an AI prompting and design competition, organising participant entry and creative challenges into one distinct experience.
caseStudy.challenge: Bring several kinds of competition rounds into a single participant journey. Teams need a clear entry point, understandable instructions, and a way to move through each challenge.
caseStudy.solution: Team-code entry introduces a sequence of timed and creative rounds, including a quiz, image recreation, a comedy bonus, and logo design, with a route to results.
features: Image recreation and creative design challenges
caseStudy.design: A bold typographic direction and high-contrast interface make the platform feel like an event while keeping the participant actions clear.

projects.name: Talent Hunt 2K26
projects.description: A bold Crescent CSE event website featuring 16 technical and non-technical competitions, event discovery, schedules, venues, FAQs, and coordinators.

caseStudy.headline: One stage. Sixteen ways to stand out.
caseStudy.intro: An energetic event website for Crescent CSE, bringing technical and non-technical competitions, schedules, and event information together.
caseStudy.challenge: Present sixteen competitions without overwhelming visitors. Participants need to discover the right events and quickly find schedules, venues, FAQs, and the people to contact.
caseStudy.solution: A strong event identity anchors the homepage. Organised event discovery and supporting information give each competition a place, with practical details accessible across mobile and desktop.
features: Event discovery and individual event information
caseStudy.design: Oversized type, expressive colour, and purposeful motion create the energy of a college event while maintaining a consistent structure for its information.
